title: Choose FlowTrace's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Situation Report. Keep it, take my pick or an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Situation Report
options.lineage: OCHA humanitarian sitreps and the FTS funding tracker
options.thesis: FlowTrace reads like the sitrep NGO leaders already trust, but it's about their own money and it updates live.
options.viewport: Sitrep masthead dated 'as of'. Headline and the demo action on the left; live key figures and funding bars by donor on the right, built from demo data.
options.risk: It could slide into generic dashboard blue if the report grammar (rules, dates, coverage bars) isn't held strictly.

raised.raise: Verification state is drawn by the line's pattern (solid = evidenced, dashed = awaiting proof, broken = flagged), never by colour alone, everywhere in the app.
One strict module grid; history renders ghosted and the newest movement arrives bright.
Selecting a flow isolates it and dims the rest; line weight carries amount.
Type size carries magnitude: key figures are set at a scale proportional to what they report.

options.label: Duplicate Receipt Book
options.lineage: carbon-copy duplicate receipt books in every Kenyan office
options.thesis: One transaction, every copy it needs: the white copy goes to the board, pink to donors, yellow to the public.
options.viewport: The open receipt book on its cover: a numbered receipt with its proof stamp, the donor and public copies fanned behind, headline and the demo action on the cover.
options.risk: Skeuomorphic. Charming on the landing page, harder to carry into dense app screens without turning into a costume.

options.label: Normalled Jackfield
options.thesis: Every flow is a numbered lane tied to its default by an amber link line.
options.viewport: Numbered amber lanes on black glass, one inverted amber plate per screen.
options.case: NGO leaders don't recognise a machine room. Black glass reads as a tool costume.
options.kept: State drawn by stroke pattern, not hue.

options.label: Brick Build Instructions
options.thesis: A grant's journey told as numbered build steps.
options.viewport: Oversized step numerals, a 1:1 proof call-out box.
options.case: The playful register undercuts trust for finance leads.
options.kept: Strict module grid, with history ghosted and the new movement bright.

options.label: Particle Event Display
options.thesis: Money as tracks curling out of one frozen event.
options.case: Spectacle over clarity; it's heavy on 3G and low-end Android.
options.kept: Select a track to isolate it; weight carries amount.

options.label: Massin Stage Page
options.thesis: Donor and NGO voices typeset as dialogue.
options.viewport: Two voices colliding across the gutter.

options.label: Lowbrow Gallery Panel
options.case: No connection to the audience or the product.
options.kept: Total commitment: colour owns whole regions, not accents.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.thesis: Time read as light moving through a section.
options.viewport: One long section with a moving beam.
options.case: Beautiful but abstract; it doesn't say what the product does.
options.kept: Tabular 'as of' time stamps on every figure.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean SaaS landing page and dashboard, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and two buttons beside an app screenshot, then feature rows.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other fintech, which is what you said to avoid.
